Hymn 311: We Meet Again as Sisters
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: C Major
Composer: Paul L. Anderson
Lyricist/Text Author: Paul L. Anderson
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 311 titled "We Meet Again as Sisters" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in C Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Paul L. Anderson and the lyrics were written by Paul L. Anderson.
